mapper.update: INSERT INTO world_states (novel_id, chapter_no, state) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{chapterNo}, #{state}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (novel_id, chapter_no) WHERE is_deleted = FALSE DO UPDATE SET state = EXCLUDED.state, update_time = now()
mapper.select: SELECT state::text FROM world_states WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no < #{beforeChapter} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY chapter_no DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE world_states SET state = #{stateJson}::jsonb, update_time = now() WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no=#{chapterNo} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO world_states (novel_id, chapter_no, state) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{chapterNo}, #{stateJson}::jsonb)
